topic: Flavor settlement receipts have a browser-session lifetime
problem: A short toast cannot support deliberate review of consequences
solution: Keep a dismissible receipt inside existing Needs you card until page reload and show changed meter names
lesson: Receipt survives Dashboard refresh but deliberately ends on browser reload; saved decision and actual meter changes persist. Browser automation argument failure is separately logged rather than treated as an HTTP rejection

topic: Reporting-only flavor feedback can preserve complete state

lesson: Actual deltas and no-op rows can explain settlement while retaining byte-equivalent GameState/mechanics; future choices continue to hide outcomes
